items.scope: All CyberDanube products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party hardware/software discovered by CyberDanube or partners actively engaged in vulnerability research coordination, which are not within the scope of another CNA.
All Payara Platform product distributions (Payara Server, Micro, Embedded) for both Enterprise (commercial) and Community (OSS) distributions.
Everpure (formerly Pure Storage, Inc.) products only.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.
Vulnerabilities in Intigriti products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Intigriti that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Supermicro branded products, managed system, or software projects.
Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash, X-Pack, and Elastic Cloud Enterprise products only.
Current versions of LINE Messenger Application for iOS, Android, Mac, and Windows, plus LINE Open Source projects hosted on https://github.com/line.
All Acronis products, including Acronis Cyber Protect, Acronis Cyber Protect Home Office, Acronis DeviceLock DLP, and Acronis Snap Deploy.
PaperCut MF, PaperCut NG, PaperCut Hive, PaperCut Pocket, PaperCut Mobility Print, QRdoc, PaperCut Views, PaperCut Multiverse, https://www.papercut.com, and all other PaperCut products and services.
All Vaadin products and supported open source projects hosted at https://github.com/vaadin.
Jamf issues and Jamf Open Source.
Vulnerabilities in products and services under the Canon brand.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
Products and projects covered by its bug bounty programs that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Snow Software products.
All Fortra products and vulnerabilities discovered by Fortra in other products not covered by the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerabilities discovered by, reported to, or coordinated by, SCHUTZWERK unless covered by another CNA.

All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
Omron Group companies’ Industrial Automation, Healthcare, Social Systems, Device & Module Solutions issues only.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerabilities in software, services, and infrastructure owned and managed by Spartans Security, and vulnerabilities researched and found by Spartans Security in third-party products that are not part of another CNA's scope.
Ericsson issues only.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
All HYPR products only.
Siemens issues only.
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
Thinkst Applied Research’s products only.
Vulnerabilities discovered by SRA that are not within the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bombadil Systems that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Products, services, and solutions developed by Canon EMEA, Canon USA Inc., and those from IRIS, NT-ware, Onyx Graphics Inc., and Therefore Corporation, which are not under the Canon Brand.
End of life open source projects supported by HeroDevs if hosted on HeroDevs.com, or issues in open source projects discovered by or reported to HeroDevs, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Kong products; Kong Konnect, Kong Enterprise, Kong Mesh, and Kong Insomnia, including Kong Opensource; Kong Gateway, Kuma, Insomnia.
Teltonika Networks products and services only.
Mautic core and officially supported plugins.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Juniper issues only.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.

All Trellix Enterprise (formerly McAfee Enterprise and FireEye) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Trellix Advanced Research Center (Trellix ACR) that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All HiddenLayer systems, services, and products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by HiddenLayer that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in linqi products only.

All Ping Identity and ForgeRock products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Ping Identity or ForgeRock that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Microchip Technology products only.
All Gallagher security products only.
Vulnerabilities in Snyk products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Snyk that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All products and services developed and operated by FPT Software, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by FPT Software that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in runZero products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, runZero that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All upKeeper Solutions products, excluding end-of-life (EOL) as listed in the upKeeper Solutions End of Life Policy.
NEC issues only.
